title: Consensus Miami 2027 travel guide: Hotels, flights, and attendee tips
summary: Plan your Consensus Miami 2027 trip with hotel guidance, airport transportation, registration costs, per diem rates, and attendee tips.
body_markdown:
Produced by CoinDesk, Consensus Miami brings together leaders from digital assets, institutional finance, technology, and policy for three days of sessions, demonstrations, networking, and dealmaking.\[1\]\[2\] The full 2027 agenda and speaker lineup haven’t been released, but the announced program will focus on crypto at scale, institutional integration, and agentic commerce.\[1\]


## What is Consensus Miami and who is it for?


Consensus Miami is CoinDesk’s annual digital assets, finance, and technology event. Consensus Miami 2027 will take place May 4-6, 2027, at the Miami Beach Convention Center and other locations across Miami Beach.\[1\]\[2\]


Attendees include executives, investors, founders, developers, policymakers, legal professionals, and representatives from exchanges, financial institutions, technology companies, and startups. They come to evaluate products and potential partners, discuss regulatory and market developments, explore investment opportunities, and connect with others across the digital asset ecosystem.


CoinDesk expects more than 15,000 attendees from over 100 countries, with 72% holding director-level positions or above.\[1\]\[3\] These projections provide a useful sense of the event’s scale, although final 2027 attendance may differ. Planning ahead can help you make better use of the week and return with relevant insights, new contacts, and clear next steps.


## What makes Consensus Miami 2027 worth the trip


Consensus Miami gives attendees opportunities to meet potential investors and business partners, evaluate digital asset technologies in person, and discuss market and policy developments with professionals from across finance, technology, and government. The detailed 2027 agenda and speaker lineup haven’t been published, but the event’s confirmed format provides several ways to make the trip valuable.


Here are some of the experiences you can expect:


- **Deal Flow Zone:** Connect with founders, investors, and other industry professionals through a space designed for meetings and dealmaking. Review eligibility and access details for your pass before building the Deal Flow Zone into your schedule.\[3\]
- **Exhibition floor:** Meet technology providers, watch product demonstrations, and compare potential partners in one place. Build a prioritized exhibitor list once the 2027 floor plan becomes available, but leave time to explore companies you didn’t plan to visit.
- **Stages and summits:** Attend sessions covering crypto at scale, institutional integration, agentic commerce, and other developments across digital assets and finance.\[1\] Sessions are subject to capacity and available on a first-come, first-served basis, although most will also be livestreamed and available on demand.\[2\]
- **Structured networking:** Take part in speed networking, guided connections, roundtable discussions, meetups, and other facilitated formats designed to connect attendees with relevant industry professionals.\[4\]
- **Side events:** The Pro Pass includes access to hundreds of side events.\[3\] Review the official schedule once it becomes available and prioritize events that align with your professional goals rather than trying to attend as many as possible.


Pass options provide different levels of access to lounges, meeting spaces, dining, expedited badge pickup, and other benefits. Compare the current Pro, Pro+, and Premier offerings before registering to determine which features are relevant to your schedule and meeting plans.\[3\]


## Where to stay for Consensus Miami 2027


Choosing the right hotel can simplify your trip to the Miami Beach Convention Center, especially if your schedule includes sessions, exhibition floor time, and meetings throughout the day. Hotels along James Avenue provide some of the shortest walks, while properties near Collins Avenue and Lincoln Road may offer more options in exchange for a slightly longer route.

### Hotel pricing at Consensus Miami 2027


Navan analyzed anonymized hotel bookings near the Miami Beach Convention Center during Consensus week 2026.\[5\] The figures provide context for planning a 2027 trip, but they don’t predict rates during Consensus Miami 2027.


- **Median hotel rate:** The median nightly rate near the convention center was $373.\[5\]
- **Stay length:** Business travelers booked an average stay of 2.9 nights.\[5\]
- **Late bookings:** Approximately 45.4% of stays were booked within two weeks of arrival.\[5\]
- **Booking window:** The median nightly rate was $332 for bookings made one to two months ahead, compared with $442 during the final seven days — a difference of $110 per night.\[5\]


Hotel rates during Consensus week 2026 were comparable to those recorded near the convention center during the analyzed period in mid-April.\[5\] When planning for 2027, compare current South Beach rates with your company’s lodging limit rather than assuming the event will create a specific rate increase.


The official Consensus site doesn’t currently list a 2027 hotel block. If you book before confirmed housing information becomes available, consider a refundable reservation that you can compare with any eventual room-block rates and policies.


### Miami flight trends


Miami International Airport (MIA) is the primary airport for travelers attending events at the Miami Beach Convention Center and is approximately 12 miles from the venue.\[4\]\[7\] Navan flight data from Consensus week 2026 includes 662 business travel bookings to the Miami area, with 19.3% originating outside the U.S.\[5\] The most common origin locations were New York, Newark, San Francisco, Washington, D.C., and Chicago.


Arriving Sunday, May 2, or Monday, May 3, provides time to check in, collect your badge during Monday’s published registration hours, and prepare before the event begins Tuesday.\[2\] Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL), approximately 26 miles from the convention center, may provide an alternative when flight schedules or fares are more convenient.\[4\]

## Set your Miami Beach budget before traveling


Plan your Consensus Miami 2027 budget around registration, lodging, transportation, meals, and other travel expenses. Pass prices vary by access level, while hotels within walking distance of the Miami Beach Convention Center may cost more than your company’s usual lodging allowance.


### Federal per diem for Miami Beach


The U.S. General Services Administration sets federal per diem rates for lodging, meals, and incidental expenses. These rates apply to federal employees traveling on official business, although some companies also use them as benchmarks when setting travel budgets and reimbursement limits.


For Consensus Miami 2027, the FY2027 rates for Miami and Miami-Dade County are:


- **$286 per day combined:** Includes $194 for nightly lodging plus $92 for daily meals and incidental expenses (M&IE)\[6\]
- **M&IE breakdown:** Includes $23 for breakfast, $26 for lunch, $38 for dinner, and $5 for incidentals\[6\]
- **First and last travel days:** Includes an M&IE allowance of $69, or 75% of the daily M&IE rate\[6\]


The $194 federal lodging allowance is $179 lower than the $373 median nightly rate in Navan’s Consensus-week 2026 hotel data.\[5\]\[6\] If your company uses GSA rates as a benchmark, compare hotels across the walkable South Beach area and account for additional transportation costs before choosing a less expensive property farther from the convention center.


### Other expenses to consider


Planning for these expenses before you book can make it easier to set a realistic budget and avoid surprises when submitting your expense report.


- **Conference registration:** Current published prices are $699 for a Pro Pass, $1,499 for a Pro+ Pass, and $4,999 for a Premier Pass. Access to stages, networking spaces, dining, lounges, and other benefits varies by pass. Check the official registration page for current prices and inclusions before purchasing.\[3\]
- **Group discounts:** CoinDesk currently offers discounts of 5% for groups of three or more, 10% for groups of five or more, and 20% for groups of 10 or more. Confirm the applicable code and terms before registering.\[3\]
- **Registration changes:** Passes are nonrefundable but may be transferred to another person at no charge through Monday, April 5, 2027. Transfer requests submitted after that date aren’t guaranteed.\[2\]\[3\]
- **Airport transportation:** Budget for public transit, a taxi, or a rideshare between MIA and Miami Beach. The Route 150 Airport Express costs $2.25, while taxi and rideshare prices vary based on traffic and demand.\[7\]\[8\]
- **Hotel fees and taxes:** Lodging taxes, parking, deposits, and cancellation policies vary by hotel. Compare the total stay cost rather than the advertised nightly rate.
- **Conference-provided meals:** The Pro+ and Premier passes currently include designated dining benefits. Review your pass inclusions and reduce your meal allowance if required by your company’s policy.\[3\]
- **Meals and client dinners:** Budget for meals that aren’t included with your pass. Restaurants near the convention center and elsewhere in South Beach may require advance reservations during a major event.
- **After-hours networking:** Consensus advertises hundreds of side events, some of which may require separate registration or additional transportation. Leave room in your budget until the complete 2027 schedule is available.\[3\]
- **Extended stay:** If you depart Friday, May 7, include Thursday night’s lodging and any additional Friday transportation and meal expenses in your budget.


## Plan your Consensus Miami agenda


Consensus Miami 2027 is confirmed for May 4-6, but the session times, speaker lineup, exhibition floor hours, Deal Flow Zone schedule, and side-event calendar haven’t been published. Use the confirmed badge schedule to plan your arrival, but wait for the complete agenda before finalizing your departure. Badge pickup is available Monday, May 3, through Thursday, May 6.\[2\]


Attendees must collect their own credentials and present a government-issued photo ID.\[2\] Arriving Monday provides time to check in and collect your badge before the event begins Tuesday. If you plan to attend programming throughout the final day, consider departing Friday, May 7, once CoinDesk confirms Thursday’s closing time.


## What to pack and wear at Consensus Miami


Consensus doesn’t have a general dress code for the conference and festival, although individual side events may set their own requirements.\[2\] Business casual clothing, such as slacks, collared shirts, blouses, and comfortable shoes, should work for most conference activities. Consider bringing a blazer or another polished option for investor meetings, client dinners, and evening events.


Early May in Miami Beach typically brings daytime highs around 81-82°F (27-28°C) and overnight lows near 72°F (22°C), along with considerable humidity.\[10\] Pack lightweight clothing for outdoor walks and a layer you can add inside air-conditioned meeting rooms and exhibition spaces.


### Conference essentials


A few practical items can make three days of sessions, meetings, exhibits, and networking more comfortable. Add these essentials to your packing list:


- **Two pairs of comfortable shoes:** Rotating shoes can help when you’re walking to the convention center and spending hours on the exhibition floor.
- **Portable charger:** Messages, contact exchanges, notes, photos, and livestreams can quickly drain your phone’s battery.
- **Reusable water bottle:** Miami’s heat and humidity make it important to drink water throughout the day.
- **Light sweater or jacket:** Meeting rooms and exhibition spaces may feel considerably cooler than the temperature outside.
- **Compact umbrella:** May weather can include sudden rain, especially when you’re walking between your hotel, the convention center, and off-site events.
- **Small or clear bag:** Event entrances may include bag searches and security screening. CoinDesk recommends considering a clear bag to make entry faster.\[2\]
- **Government-issued photo ID:** You must present identification and collect your own badge at registration.\[2\]


## Getting from the airport to the Consensus Miami venue


Miami International Airport (MIA) is approximately 12 miles from the Miami Beach Convention Center and is the primary airport for Consensus attendees.\[4\]\[7\] Arriving Monday, May 3, provides time to check in and collect your badge before the event begins Tuesday. A Sunday arrival may provide additional flexibility if your schedule and travel policy allow.


For travelers with luggage, a rideshare or taxi is generally the simplest way to reach Miami Beach. Route 150, the Miami Beach Airport Express, offers a lower-cost alternative but requires additional travel time.

Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL), approximately 26 miles from the convention center, may offer an alternative when its fares or flight schedules are more convenient. However, account for the longer transfer and possible traffic before choosing FLL over MIA.\[4\]


Once you reach Miami Beach, walking may be the simplest option for trips between a nearby hotel, the convention center, and Lincoln Road. The free Miami Beach Trolley and Freebee service may provide alternatives for longer local trips, depending on their current routes and operating hours.\[4\]\[13\]


## Beyond sessions: Make time for the Deal Flow Zone and exhibition floor


Consensus combines educational programming with an exhibition floor, structured networking, and a Deal Flow Zone designed to connect founders, investors, and other industry professionals.\[3\] The 2027 exhibitor directory, floor plan, event app, and operating hours haven’t been published, so wait for those details before planning specific routes or meeting times.


- **Review the exhibitor directory:** Once the 2027 directory becomes available, identify the companies and professionals most relevant to your work and group nearby booths together.
- **Prioritize the Deal Flow Zone:** Set aside time for structured networking and meetings rather than treating the area as another part of the exhibition floor. Confirm access requirements and operating hours for your pass before building it into your schedule.\[3\]
- **Schedule additional meetings:** Contact investors, founders, customers, partners, and colleagues approximately two weeks before the event to arrange meetings outside scheduled networking activities.
- **Use the event app:** If CoinDesk releases a 2027 app, use it to save sessions and exhibitors, review schedule changes, navigate the venue, and manage meetings.
- **Take notes after each conversation:** Record relevant details, open questions, contacts, and agreed-upon next steps while the discussion is still fresh.
- **Follow up within 48 hours:** Send a brief email or LinkedIn message that references the conversation and confirms the next action.
- **Build in short breaks:** Three days of sessions, exhibits, meetings, and off-site events can be tiring. Leave time to eat, drink water, organize your notes, and recharge between commitments.


Focus on a manageable list of priority contacts rather than trying to visit every exhibitor or attend every networking event. Leaving open periods in your schedule also gives you time for useful conversations that weren’t arranged in advance.


## What to eat at Consensus Miami 2027


The Pro+ and Premier passes currently include designated dining benefits, while Pro Pass holders should plan for their own meals.\[3\] Confirm your pass inclusions and the event’s meal schedule before traveling, and keep a snack in your bag for periods when sessions, exhibits, and meetings leave little time to eat.


When it’s time for a client dinner, team meal, or quick lunch, these options are convenient to the Miami Beach Convention Center:


- **Client or team meal:** Rum Room at 2100 Washington Ave. is located on the convention center campus and accepts reservations, making it a convenient option when you don’t want to travel farther into South Beach.\[11\]
- **Casual group meal:** La Cerveceria de Barrio at 836 Lincoln Road serves Mexican food in a casual setting suitable for lunch or an informal team dinner.\[14\]
- **Quick meal:** Lincoln Eatery offers several fast-casual and grab-and-go options when a group wants different cuisines or has limited time.\[4\]


Restaurants and operating hours may change before May 2027, so check current information and make reservations before traveling. Navan Edge can book Miami Beach restaurants in the same chat where you arrange your flight and hotel.


## Finish strong on departure day


Before you check out, take a few minutes to organize your receipts, notes, and new contacts so you’re not sorting through everything after you return home. Allow enough time to travel from Miami Beach to MIA, check your bags, and clear security before your flight.


- **Pack the night before:** Charge your devices, organize your receipts and notes, and check the room for chargers, badges, and other belongings.
- **Confirm late checkout:** If you have an afternoon or evening flight, ask the front desk about late checkout or have Navan Edge coordinate the request on your behalf.
- **Allow time for the airport transfer:** Traffic between Miami Beach and MIA can increase travel times, particularly during busy periods. Check current conditions before leaving your hotel.
- **Arrive early at the airport:** Allow at least two hours for a domestic flight and three hours for an international departure.
- **Submit expenses early:** Upload hotel, meal, and transportation receipts while the charges are still easy to identify, following your company’s expense policy.
- **Begin your follow-ups:** Use time at the airport or on your return trip to organize contacts and send brief messages confirming agreed-upon next steps.
- **Schedule a debrief:** Block time early the following week to share relevant findings, review potential partners, and decide which conversations require further action.


## Make the most of your Consensus Miami 2027 trip


Consensus Miami brings thousands of digital asset, finance, technology, and policy professionals together for three days of sessions, exhibits, meetings, and networking. Choose a hotel based on its complete route to the convention center, compare South Beach rates with your lodging allowance, and revisit your plans as the 2027 agenda, exhibitor directory, and Deal Flow Zone schedule become available.
